lines.zh: 我后退着走，让距离保持不变。
lines.en: I walk backward to keep the distance unchanged.

lines.zh: 天堂的云离我很远，我喜欢这样。
lines.en: The clouds of Haven stay far from me, which I like.

lines.zh: 我走的每一步都在拉开，不是靠近。
lines.en: Every step I take widens the gap, never closes it.

lines.zh: 脚跟几乎不着地，风替我抬着。
lines.en: My heels barely touch; the wind lifts them.

lines.zh: 我在高处巡，视野比脚步更重要。
lines.en: I patrol high ground; sight matters more than steps.

lines.zh: 你向前，我就往后，这是规矩。
lines.en: You advance, I retreat; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 我沿着天堂的石栏走，手不离栏。
lines.en: I walk along Haven's railing, hand never leaving it.

lines.zh: 风推我，我顺着它偏一点。
lines.en: The wind pushes, and I lean with it a little.

lines.zh: 我的脚步轻，但我的目光很重。
lines.en: My steps are light, but my gaze is heavy.

lines.zh: 走这条路，我能看见三个人。
lines.en: From this road I can see three people.

lines.zh: 天堂的雾在我身后合上。
lines.en: The mist of Haven closes behind me.

lines.zh: 我从不站在人多的那一侧。
lines.en: I never stand on the crowded side.

lines.zh: 我停在高处，像一支还没射的箭。
lines.en: I stop on high ground, like an arrow not yet loosed.

lines.zh: 天堂的光太散，我在等它收拢。
lines.en: Haven's light is too scattered; I wait for it to gather.

lines.zh: 手指间有一点冷在转。
lines.en: A bit of cold turns between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把距离量了第三遍，还是满意。
lines.en: I measure the distance a third time and remain satisfied.

lines.zh: 没有呼吸，就没有紧张。
lines.en: No breath means no nervousness.

lines.zh: 我数天堂的塔尖，一共九个。
lines.en: I count the spires of Haven: nine in all.

lines.zh: 云影盖住我时，我才算休息。
lines.en: Only when a cloud shades me do I rest.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比天堂的石头还老。
lines.en: My patience is older than the stones of Haven.

lines.zh: 我不看近处，近处容易骗人。
lines.en: I do not look near; near things lie easily.

lines.zh: 手里的光慢慢转成一枚针。
lines.en: The light in my hand slowly turns into a needle.

lines.zh: 很远的那个影子，动了一下。
lines.en: That shadow far off just moved once.

lines.zh: 我把自己站成一条线。
lines.en: I stand until I become a line.

lines.zh: 风带走了灰，也带走了我的声音。
lines.en: The wind takes the ash and my voice with it.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见箭在弦上。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear the arrow on the string.

lines.zh: 我在数自己还能站多久。
lines.en: I am counting how much longer I can stand.

lines.zh: 风从石栏那头来，我偏了偏头。
lines.en: Wind comes along the stone rail. I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 你太近了，我往后退了半步。
lines.en: You are too close; I take half a step back.

lines.zh: 我在估你走到我这里要几步。
lines.en: I am estimating how many steps bring you to me.

lines.zh: 你的甲在光下很亮，很好瞄准。
lines.en: Your armor shines in the light, easy to aim at.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我却在你侧面。
lines.en: You look up for me; I am at your side.

lines.zh: 我看的是你的手，不是你的脸。
lines.en: Your hands matter to me; your face does not.

lines.zh: 你带着弓，这让我不太放心。
lines.en: You carry a bow, which makes me uneasy.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸有点乱，我记下了。
lines.en: Your breathing is uneven; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 别把手举高，我会以为是信号。
lines.en: Do not raise your hand; I will read it as a signal.

lines.zh: 天堂的活人通常站得没这么直。
lines.en: The living in Haven rarely stand this straight.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛眯起，看清你的喉咙。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes to see your throat clearly.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，远处就能看见。
lines.en: You carry iron; it shows from far away.

lines.zh: 你不像来祈祷的，也不像来送死的。
lines.en: You look neither like a pilgrim nor like a dead man.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我的客气就没了。
lines.en: One step closer and my courtesy is finished.

lines.zh: 我先看你的脚，脚不会撒谎。
lines.en: I look at your feet first; feet do not lie.

lines.zh: 你把光打散了，它还会聚。
lines.en: You scattered the light; it will gather again.

lines.zh: 这一下让你近了半步，很糟。
lines.en: That blow brought you half a step closer; bad.

lines.zh: 我退，是为了继续射。
lines.en: I retreat so that I may keep shooting.

lines.zh: 我不流血，只漏一点凉。
lines.en: I do not bleed; I only leak a little cold.

lines.zh: 疼会让我把距离拉得更开。
lines.en: Pain makes me widen the distance further.

lines.zh: 你打中了，可你没打准。
lines.en: You landed a hit, but not a good one.

lines.zh: 我还要站很久，不能在这里散。
lines.en: I must stand a long while yet; I cannot scatter here.

lines.zh: 你的剑很快，我的眼更快。
lines.en: Your blade is fast; my eye is faster.

lines.zh: 我会记住你的出手习惯。
lines.en: I will remember how you swing.

lines.zh: 虽然散了也不掉东西，但我不想散。
lines.en: Scattering drops nothing, but I still would rather not.

lines.zh: 你想用食物换距离，做不到。
lines.en: You want to trade food for distance; it cannot be done.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，但没有走近。
lines.en: I smell it, and I do not come closer.

lines.zh: 把手举高些，我好看清你的诚意。
lines.en: Raise your hands higher so I can see your sincerity.

lines.zh: 天堂不吃东西，我们只是看着。
lines.en: Haven does not eat; we only watch.

lines.zh: 那块肉在你手上，比在我这里安全。
lines.en: That meat is safer in your hand than mine.

lines.zh: 你往前一步，我就退两步。
lines.en: For your one step forward, I give two back.

lines.zh: 我不饿，但我很想靠近一次。
lines.en: I am not hungry, but I want to come close once.

lines.zh: 别抖，食物掉了我也不会捡。
lines.en: Do not shake; if it falls I will not pick it up.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起活着的时候。
lines.en: This smell reminds me of when I was alive.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，然后退开，好吗。
lines.en: Leave it there and step away, would you?

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我的距离全乱了。
lines.en: You crash into me and my distance is ruined.

lines.zh: 我立刻退开三步，重新量。
lines.en: I retreat three paces at once and measure again.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你的皮肤会先麻。
lines.en: Touch me, and your skin goes numb first.

lines.zh: 我不擅长近身，所以我讨厌这个。
lines.en: I am poor at close quarters, which is why I hate this.

lines.zh: 你把我撞得偏了，箭也会偏。
lines.en: You knocked me off line, and my arrow will stray.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头，天堂听见了。
lines.en: Bone on bone; Haven heard it.

lines.zh: 退后，我们都不该站这么近。
lines.en: Back away; neither of us belongs this close.

lines.zh: 我贴着石栏滑开，没让你抓住。
lines.en: I slide along the railing before you can grab me.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我记你一次失礼。
lines.en: For that collision I mark you as rude.

lines.zh: 我的冷留在了你的肩上。
lines.en: My cold stayed on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 另一个保护者也守着一边，我们从不并肩。
lines.en: The other protector guards the far side; we never stand together.

lines.zh: 我们隔着很远的距离交换过一次眼神。
lines.en: We traded one glance across a very long distance.

lines.zh: 同类不必靠近，也能配合。
lines.en: Our kind need not be close to work together.

lines.zh: 她射左，我射右，不用说话。
lines.en: She shoots left, I shoot right, without a word.

lines.zh: 我们只在天堂开裂时才站到一起。
lines.en: We stand together only when Haven cracks.

lines.zh: 我记得她的手法，比记得她的脸清楚。
lines.en: I remember her aim better than her face.

lines.zh: 靠近会打乱准头，我们懂这个。
lines.en: Closeness spoils aim; we both know that.

lines.zh: 很久以前，我们曾共用一个名字。
lines.en: Long ago we shared a single name.

lines.zh: 她散开那次，我替她守了三天。
lines.en: When she scattered, I guarded her post three days.

lines.zh: 我们从不道别，只换个方向站。
lines.en: We never say farewell, only turn another way.

lines.zh: 我伸手去接，箭却穿过了掌。
lines.en: I reach to catch it, and it passes my palm.

lines.zh: 地上这些东西，我一件都不缺。
lines.en: Of all these things on the ground, I lack none.

lines.zh: 我把它拨远，免得挡住射界。
lines.en: I push it aside so it will not block my shot.

lines.zh: 捡不起来的东西，我从来不留。
lines.en: I never keep what I cannot lift.

lines.zh: 你掉落的东西，我替你看着。
lines.en: I keep an eye on what you dropped.

lines.zh: 手指合拢，只抓到一点冷气。
lines.en: My fingers close on a little cold air.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，但我想拿一次。
lines.en: I do not need it, but I want to hold it once.

lines.zh: 这石头真沉，压得草都弯了。
lines.en: This stone is heavy; it bends the grass.

lines.zh: 我把它留在原处，位置很重要。
lines.en: I leave it where it lies; position matters.

lines.zh: 别把东西塞给我，我会让它掉。
lines.en: Do not press things into my hands; I will drop them.

lines.zh: 你在射程里了，我这才抬手。
lines.en: You are in range; only now do I raise my hand.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的胸口，那里最好打。
lines.en: I lock on your chest; it is the easiest target.

lines.zh: 天堂的规矩：活人不许带剑。
lines.en: Haven's rule: the living may not carry blades.

lines.zh: 我算了风，也算退路，你没有。
lines.en: I have measured the wind and your escape; you have none.

lines.zh: 这个距离我很满意，你不会喜欢。
lines.en: I am satisfied with this distance; you will not be.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的准星就跟着动。
lines.en: Move, and my aim moves with you.

lines.zh: 我不是恨你，我只是接到了命令。
lines.en: I do not hate you; I simply received an order.

lines.zh: 抬弓的人，一向先被选中。
lines.en: The one who raises a bow is always chosen first.

lines.zh: 你站在光里，太方便了。
lines.en: You stand in the light, which is very convenient.

lines.zh: 我在远处，远得你以为安全。
lines.en: I am far away, far enough that you feel safe.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，你只能往前跑。
lines.en: From this moment, you can only run forward.

lines.zh: 准星落在你身上，就不收了。
lines.en: The aim rests on you, and I will not withdraw it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢后退，把距离拉到最好。
lines.en: I retreat slowly, stretching the distance to its best.

lines.zh: 你追我，我就在退的路上瞄你。
lines.en: Chase me, and I aim while retreating.

lines.zh: 这一箭我给风留了余地。
lines.en: I left some room for the wind in this shot.

lines.zh: 你在石头后面，我等得起。
lines.en: You are behind a stone; I can wait.

lines.zh: 我的针会在你抬手时离手。
lines.en: My needle leaves my hand when yours rises.

lines.zh: 天堂的高处，是我的位置。
lines.en: The high ground of Haven is my place.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我就换角度。
lines.en: You change direction; I change angle.

lines.zh: 我不看你的剑，只看你的膝。
lines.en: I do not watch your sword, only your knees.

lines.zh: 距离每缩一米，我就补一箭。
lines.en: For every meter you close, I add an arrow.

lines.zh: 你喘得乱了，我的针等着。
lines.en: You are panting out of rhythm; my needle waits.

lines.zh: 这枚光针不算快，但不会偏。
lines.en: This needle is not fast, but it will not stray.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就该动了。
lines.en: I count to three, and then you should move.

lines.zh: 站在原地的猎物，最没有意思。
lines.en: Prey that stands still is the least interesting.

lines.zh: 我被迫近身，这一下不算漂亮。
lines.en: Forced into melee, and this blow is not pretty.

lines.zh: 光针贴脸炸开，你的视野会白。
lines.en: The needle bursts at your face; your sight goes white.

lines.zh: 十一点五的重量，烧在你肋骨上。
lines.en: Eleven and a half points burn on your ribs.

lines.zh: 我用手肘推你，只是要退开。
lines.en: I nudge you with my elbow only to get space.

lines.zh: 别以为近了就安全，我也有手。
lines.en: Do not think closeness is safety; I have hands too.

lines.zh: 这一掌很冷，冷到骨头里。
lines.en: This palm is cold, cold down to the bone.

lines.zh: 你抓住了我的袖子，抓到的只是雾。
lines.en: You grabbed my sleeve and caught only mist.

lines.zh: 我打你胸口，是为了让你退。
lines.en: I strike your chest to make you step back.

lines.zh: 近身之后，我的箭反而更准。
lines.en: Up close my arrow is somehow more accurate.

lines.zh: 抱歉，这个距离我从不留手。
lines.en: Forgive me; at this range I never hold back.

lines.zh: 天堂的石栏上多了一层光，那是我。
lines.en: A layer of light appears on Haven's railing; that is me.

lines.zh: 我在远处成形，先有的是眼睛。
lines.en: I take shape far off, and the eyes come first.

lines.zh: 云散开一条缝，我从中看出去。
lines.en: The clouds part a seam, and I look through it.

lines.zh: 上一个保护者散了，位置空着。
lines.en: The last protector scattered, and the post stood empty.

lines.zh: 我不落地，只悬在石阶上方。
lines.en: I do not land; I hover above the stone steps.

lines.zh: 天堂需要一双眼，于是有了我。
lines.en: Haven needed an eye, and so I was made.

lines.zh: 风里多了一点凉，你该警觉。
lines.en: The wind turns a little colder; you should be wary.

lines.zh: 我在塔尖旁边出现，从不走在路中间。
lines.en: I appear beside the spire, never in the middle of the road.

lines.zh: 很远的地方亮了一下，那就是我。
lines.en: Something far off glinted once; that was me.

lines.zh: 我刚来，就已经在量你了。
lines.en: I have only just arrived, and I am already measuring you.

lines.zh: 天堂的门开了一条缝，我进来了。
lines.en: A crack opened in Haven's gate, and I came through.

lines.zh: 你先听见风声，才看见我。
lines.en: You hear the wind first, and then you see me.

lines.zh: 这具身体是光拼的，不太结实。
lines.en: This body is stitched from light and not very sturdy.

lines.zh: 我站在你够不到的地方，习惯如此。
lines.en: I stand where you cannot reach; that is my habit.

lines.zh: 火光让我更亮，也更难看清。
lines.en: Firelight makes me brighter and harder to see.

lines.zh: 我没有摔下去，我飘着落地。
lines.en: I did not fall; I drifted down.

lines.zh: 水困不住光，只困住一会儿。
lines.en: Water cannot hold light, only delay it.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的准星吹歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocked my aim off.

lines.zh: 你的箭穿过我，钉在后面。
lines.en: Your arrow went through and stuck behind.

lines.zh: 同样的法术，彼此都伤得深。
lines.en: The same spell; it wounds us both deeply.

lines.zh: 我不进食，只能慢慢变淡。
lines.en: I do not feed, so I slowly fade.

lines.zh: 雷追着我的光，追错了地方。
lines.en: Lightning chased my light to the wrong place.

lines.zh: 虚空吞光，我差点就散了。
lines.en: The void swallows light; I nearly scattered.
